facts.fact: Samhain 海报：Ferox Hall 礼堂外的 clapboard 招牌印着 Arthur 的照片（黑丝框新眼镜、向 Maggie 借的 tweed——「看起来一点不破旧」）——「Arthur Taliesin, Professor Emeritus」5:30-6:30 讲座；学生涌出谈论今夜假面派对「the person they hoped to find, masked, beneath the stars」。
facts.anchor: Alchemical Transformation for Technological Advancement Lecture Series: Metallic Conversions

facts.fact: 旧面具重启：花瓣干枯卷边、褪成 Beltane 时的 muted 版本——「她喜欢这种时间流逝的痕迹。他们已经是不同的人了；面具也该不同」；公寓里 30 分钟：她发布双喜——译文被 Diadhan Review 接受、会议提案入选 plenary session——他早已知道（「为你做饭、陪你熬夜、一遍遍 reassured」）「It's easy to believe in you, Maggie.」
facts.anchor: he was wearing his Beltane mask and she was wearing hers

facts.fact: 公寓床笫：她倒退着引他到沙发——黑丝袜的 thrilling challenge、一寸寸褪下；「I love you」被咬唇回应；他跪在她腿间「I will never get tired of hearing that」；数周学尽她的 pleasure——「He was a methodical researcher.」；「If Dahlia were here, she'd make you put a dollar in the jar.」

罚款罐：柜台上玻璃 jam jar 几乎塞满美元、Dahlia 的 loopy 手写标签——「Arthur's Full-of-Himself Fund」；「We don't have much time」「I'm not worried. I know what you need.」；「Come for me so we aren't late」；完事后他问「要不要干脆待在家里」——「Absolutely not. I've been waiting for this day for months. Months!」「Anything for you, love.」

Rodrigo's 酒吧：大绒毛蜘蛛与蛛网、南瓜萝卜 Jack-o'-lantern 无热 faefire、循环冷雾；Rory/Dahlia/Jim 盛装在吧台——Rodrigo 递出那张黄色便签「Calls himself TK…thirty-five」；「You looked for me?」「Well, Dahlia did.」「I've been rooting for you all along,」Dahlia 隔吧台喊。
facts.anchor: The mystery man,” Rodrigo said as they walked in

facts.fact: 心软的铁证：Arthur 把便签收进口袋——「Arthur Taliesin was a sentimental fool」；她知道他会把它钉在 Barry 家那间童年卧室的 corkboard 上、正好在挂面具的位置旁——「And she loved him for it.」；拥吻中她听着他外套下的心跳「knew, with absolute certainty, that this was where she was supposed to be.」
facts.anchor: He tucked the note in his pocket.

facts.fact: 全书终章： Branagh's Aubade 第 32 节（Dr. Magnolia Linden 译）——「Hand in hand, walking through eastern fields of gilded yarrow…Bury my body, love, my bones. Hand in hand, let me rest.」——yarrow 复生、紫杉长青、土壤记得——史诗的生死观收束全书的「面具与真容」「记忆与遗忘」。
